Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You catch the spirit at the threshold and hold up one finger. “Not quite yet.”

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One ally within 5 squares that would enter Last Words.
Duration
Until the beginning of the ally’s next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per day per character; uses your Reaction.
Type
Signature

The ally does not enter Last Words yet. It remains at 0 HP with at least three death marks until the beginning of its next turn and makes no further death rolls during the delay. If it is stabilized or healed above 0 before then, it avoids Last Words. At the beginning of its next turn, if it still has three death marks, Last Words begin.

Additional rulings
